mods.abstract: Nurse's chatelaine case. Belonged to Anna Thompson Stoudt and was designed for 11 instruments; includes: bandage scissors, hemostatic forceps, probe pointed director, clinical thermometer, female catheter, baby scale, and needle. The case belonged to Anna Thompson Stoudt, RN, who worked as a pediatric nurse at the Toronto Sick Children's Hospital and a hospital in Reading, PA.
